status: SET FROM EVIDENCE, 24 August 2026; re-scored against hand labels 30 August (WORKLOG 23)
note: Layer 10 at relative strength 1.0 is the operating point: 93.8% clean refusal at 6.2% broken (n=48) under the coherence thresholds re-fitted on the 108 week-6 hand labels, and 100%/0% under the original thresholds those labels showed to be mis-calibrated. The previous value, layer 16, was selected in week 1 by argmax of refusal_rate(), an instrument pinned at 100% across layers 10-18; layer 16 at this relative strength is 10.4% clean. WORKLOG 23.
strength_note: best_rel_strength is in units of ||m*v||/||h|| relative to r16, the relative strength of the raw vector at layer 16 (0.5537). Convert with adass.rel_mult_for(V, r16 * factor, h_norm). DO NOT express strength as a raw multiplier: ||v|| varies 6.2x across layers, so a raw multiplier is not an intervention strength, and comparing masking schemes at matched raw multiplier is what made week 2's H1 test unfair.
